The following hardware and software specifications are mandatory for Garden Suite ERP to function correctly. Hardware is to be arranged and maintained entirely by the customer. Sarbani Associates will not be responsible for any issues arising from non-compliant hardware or software environments.
Latest generation Intel Core i3 equivalent or above (Intel / AMD). Desktop preferred over laptop for operational stability.
Minimum 8 GB RAM. 16 GB recommended for multi-user or payroll-intensive use.
Minimum 512 GB SSD (Solid State Drive). Hard disk drives (HDD) are NOT acceptable due to performance and reliability concerns.
Windows — latest version, fully up to date with all security patches applied. Outdated Windows versions will not be supported.
Brave Browser — pre-installed and set as the default browser for Garden Suite ERP web access.
Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Access — pre-installed (non-negotiable). Required for reporting, data export, and local operations.
Windows Defender (built-in) only. No third-party antivirus software to be installed. Third-party antivirus may interfere with application performance and data integrity.
Desktop PC strongly preferred over laptop. Laptops introduce instability risks in field environments. Laptop use is at customer's discretion and risk.
MediaTek Dimensity 6300 / Qualcomm Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 or above. Lower-spec chipsets will result in degraded face-recognition performance.
Minimum 8 GB RAM. Required for stable face recognition and data sync operations.
Always run the latest version of Garden Suite Face App. Outdated app versions will not be supported.
Latest stable Android version as applicable to device. Keep OS updated for security and compatibility.
Minimum 64 GB internal storage recommended to accommodate app data, logs, and offline sync buffers.
Front Camera - minimum 30 MP, with good image quality and sensitivity
Stable Wi-Fi or mobile data (4G/5G) required for sync. Offline mode available but sync must be completed daily.
All hardware is to be provided and maintained by the customer. Sarbani Associates has no obligation to repair, replace, or support customer hardware.
Issues arising from software not supplied or authorised by Sarbani Associates will not be entertained or supported.

Installation of any new software on workstations used for Garden Suite ERP must be done in consultation with and approval from Sarbani Associates, due to data security and application integrity reasons.
If any unauthorised software is installed without prior approval, Sarbani Associates will not be liable for any data tampering, theft, corruption, or loss arising thereof.

Installation of third-party antivirus software is strictly discouraged. Windows Defender (built-in) is sufficient and recommended. Any data issues arising from third-party security tools are not covered under warranty or support.

The customer is responsible for ensuring that all workstations and mobile devices used with Garden Suite ERP comply with these specifications. Non-compliance voids any support or warranty obligations on the part of Sarbani Associates.
* Sarbani Associates reserves the right to suspend support if customer hardware or software environment is found to be non-compliant with these specifications.
All support is delivered online and off-site. Requests may be raised by phone, WhatsApp, email or designated remote support channels and will be addressed according to severity and business impact.
Critical: within 4 business hours. High: within 1 business day. Medium: within 2 business days. Low: within 3 business days.
Critical failures affecting payroll, attendance, data access or core operations will receive highest priority for remote diagnosis and escalation.

Cloud plans include routine backups. Data retrieval requests may require up to 3 business days depending on data volume and complexity. Customers are encouraged to maintain local exports where applicable.
Customization timelines will be provided after requirement analysis and depend on scope, complexity, and resource availability.

Implementation, configuration, data review and user training are carried out online and off-site. Timelines depend on module count, data migration, infrastructure readiness and customer availability. A remote project schedule will be shared before commencement.
